Witten & Frank [40], PEP 544/557 [37,38], Lewis et al. RAG [75], Wolpert NFL [82]: framing/background only; no protocol, data or tool taken from them.

notes: Own-toolkit paper (EZR, stdlib-only Python); comparisons to SMAC3/SHAP/LIME/ReliefF are imported from the authors' prior papers [6,25] rather than re-run here, so those steppingstone edges are medium; no third-party software executed (0 software edges); the only fresh experiments are SA-vs-LS on 20 MOOT tasks and CNB-vs-FASTREAD on Yu's four SLR corpora.
